source.author: cic
source.text: Nactus sum etiam qui Xenophontis similem esse se cuperet, cuius sermo est ille quidem melle dulcior, sed a forensi strepitu remotissimus.
source.text_original: Nactus sum etiam qui Xenophontis similem esse se cuperet, cuius sermo est ille quidem melle dulcior, sed a forensi strepitu remotissimus.
source.text_english: I even found someone who wanted to be like Xenophon, whose style is indeed sweeter than honey, but quite far removed from the noisy bustle of the forum.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: igitur, quod solum absentes facere possumus, querulas fundimus preces et desiderium nostrum non tam fletibus quam heiulatibus contestamur, ut Marcellam nostram nobis reddas et illam mitem, illam suauem, illam omni melle et dulcedine dulciorem non patiaris apud eas esse rigidam et tristem rugare frontem, quas affabilitate sua ad simile uitae studium prouocauit.
reuse.text_original: igitur, quod solum absentes facere possumus, querulas fundimus preces et desiderium nostrum non tam fletibus quam heiulatibus contestamur, ut Marcellam nostram nobis reddas et illam mitem, illam suauem, illam omni melle et dulcedine dulciorem non patiaris apud eas esse rigidam et tristem rugare frontem, quas affabilitate sua ad simile uitae studium prouocauit.
reuse.text_english: Therefore, since this is the only thing we absent persons can do, we pour forth plaintive prayers and bear witness to our longing not so much with tears as with wailings, asking that you restore our Marcella to us and do not let that gentle woman, that sweet woman, sweeter than all honey and sweetness, grow stern and sad among those whom by her graciousness she has stirred to a like zeal for life, furrowing her brow.
